Retired surgeon Dr. Richard Bosshardt makes a stark claim to Tucker Carlson: medical schools no longer demand that surgeons be good, only that they not be white. Bosshardt writes and speaks against diversity policies in medicine. His charge targets how doctors are now selected and trained.

Bosshardt describes the standards he says were lowered in the name of equity. He argues patients of every race lose when skill stops coming first. Carlson asks what changed inside the schools and who drove it. Alarmed and skeptical viewers get a doctor's blunt case against DEI in the operating room.
